description:
Title: DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen

A nifty online tool helps you with repairing your Smartphone on your own.
You start by entering the model and what is broken.
The tool gives you the list of materials, the list of tools, and (for each part) several ordering choices.
Some stuff you already have (e.g. some tools, screws).
The tool also lets you contact friends if you can borrow / buy something for cheap from them.
The rest you buy.
Afterwards you receive instructions how to fix your phone.
If it worked, send a review and/or video of you fixing it.
If it hasn't worked out, you can send it to an expert.

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Friend_Split" name="Friend can supply items?" default="Flow_Friend_No"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Borrow_Buy_Friend" name="Borrow or buy cheap items from friend"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Buy_Rest" name="Buy remaining items"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Instructions" name="Receive repair instructions"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Repair" name="Repair screen"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Result_Split" name="Repair successful?" default="Flow_Result_No"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Review and/or video?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Send_Review" name="Send review"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Send_Video" name="Send video of repair"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Join" name="Feedback sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repair_Completed" name="Repair completed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Send_Expert" name="Send phone to expert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Sent_To_Expert" name="Phone sent to expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Repair_Need" targetRef="SendTask_Submit_Model"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="SendTask_Submit_Model" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Lists"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Friend_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Friend_Split" targetRef="Task_Borrow_Buy_Friend">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Friend_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Friend_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Friend_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Borrow_Buy_Friend" targetRef="Gateway_Friend_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Friend_Join" targetRef="Task_Buy_Rest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_Buy_Rest" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Instructions"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_Result_Split"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Yes" name="Review" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="SendTask_Send_Review">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video_Yes" name="Video" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="SendTask_Send_Video">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="SendTask_Send_Review" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="SendTask_Send_Video" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join" targetRef="End_Repair_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Online_Tool" name="Online Repair Tool Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Model_Received" name="Model and damage received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Model_Received" messageRef="Msg_Model_Submitted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Tool_Done" name="Support completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Tool_Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Model_Received" targetRef="ServiceTask_Generate_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Tool_Flow_2" sourceRef="ServiceTask_Generate_Materials" targetRef="ServiceTask_Generate_Tools"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Tool_Flow_4" sourceRef="ServiceTask_Generate_Ordering" targetRef="SendTask_Send_Lists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Tool_Flow_5" sourceRef="SendTask_Send_Lists" targetRef="SendTask_Send_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Tool_Flow_6" sourceRef="SendTask_Send_Instructions" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Tool_Flow_7" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_Feedback" targetRef="EndEvent_Tool_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
